records.title: Pike
records.description:
The Pike is a Spear, a melee armament . With its extreme length plus its attack pattern of long forward stabs, the Pike has absolutely excellent forward range compared to nearly every other melee weapon, and its Stat requirement is not very high making it an excellent early option for every class, including magic users.
When skill-refitted with something like Ash of War: Spinning Slash with a wide attack arc, it also becomes very effective against clustered groups of enemies. Another good choice is Ash of War: Impaling Thrust, allowing the player to punch clean through an enemy's shield block from a sizeable distance.
